summary: An always-on ambience firmware built on Felucca: each power-on starts a new random, in-key piece, and the worlds you mark as liked shape the ones that come next.
features: Four generated parts (pulse, floor, haze, voice) over a background bed
Knobs set part volumes; three macros per part
Upper buttons are timed "verbs" such as sink, swell and scramble
Up to 16 liked worlds kept; nothing else is saved
MIDI in over USB and TRS with clock follow
No sequencer editing, presets, projects or web editor

headings: if the fm-1 does not start
